pages.title: Domen Hribernik
pages.description: Full-stack developer in Slovenia. Portfolio of hand-built web apps: a live sky atlas, 3D CSS bouquets, a tarok scorekeeper, and more, plus a blog on building small software.

views/thesis.title: Virtual Runner
views/thesis.description: My thesis focuses on creating a digital twin of a runner, integrating multiple subprojects into an application to demonstrate practical use of various technologies.

views/music.title: Guitar Backing Tracks
views/music.description: I got tired of digging through folders every time I wanted to practice. So I built a simple player that keeps all my backing tracks in one place, ready to go.

views/bearing.title: Bearing
views/bearing.description: A co-op game for two, because every other game here is one of you beating the other.

views/battleship.title: Battleship
views/battleship.description: Battleship where falling behind pays out.

views/seam.title: Seam
views/seam.description: Connect four, except the ground keeps disappearing. Play into a column that is already full and the deepest row of the whole board is cut away, so every piece drops a row and the line you were building may be gone.

views/spy.title: Spy Game
views/spy.description: Everyone knows the location except one person. That person is the spy. Pass one phone round the table, or open a room so everyone gets their own screen, votes in secret and finds out together who was lying.

views/tarok.title: Tarok Scoring
views/tarok.description: A scorekeeper for Slovenia's beloved card game. Handles radelci, multipliers, and full game history, so the table argument about who's winning stays settled.

views/beseda.title: Beseda
views/beseda.description: Duolingo doesn't teach Slovenian and the apps that do want your money, so here is a free one. A new word every day inside real sentences, where hovering any word tells you what it means.

views/tells.title: Tells
views/tells.description: A logical fallacy sits in the argument where anyone can point at it, a cognitive bias sits in your head where nobody can, and a tactic is someone triggering that bias on purpose.

views/botaniq.title: Botaniq
views/botaniq.description: Never forget to water a plant again. Add your plants, set a watering schedule, and write down exactly how to care for each one. Simple and always one glance away.

views/ip.title: Multi-Source IP Locator
views/ip.description: Asks ten independent geolocation services where an IP lives and draws every answer on one map, so you see where the consensus lands and not just one provider's best guess.

views/workout.title: Workout Tracker
views/workout.description: Build workouts from your own exercise library, whether it's reps, weights, holds, or runs, then log every round as you go. Each session is saved, so you can look back and see yourself getting stronger.

views/maze.title: Maze Generator
views/maze.description: Generate your own maze puzzles and print them out. Pick a shape, pick a style, and get a unique maze every time with the solution ready if you need it.

views/sourdough.title: Sourdough Tracker
views/sourdough.description: Good sourdough takes days, and it is easy to lose track. This keeps the whole process in one place so you always know where your dough is: fed, folded, proofing, or ready for the oven.

views/blog.title: Blog
views/blog.description: A place to write down the occasional thought on building software and the projects on this site. Rendered straight in the browser.

views/recipes.title: Recipes
views/recipes.description: A cozy recipe box where anyone can browse and cooks can write their own. A guided cooking mode walks you through each step with built in timers and a bell.

views/flowers.title: Paper Flowers
views/flowers.description: Build a bouquet out of nothing but CSS: pick roses, sunflowers, poppies and more, and every petal is a flat div rotated into place. Then send someone a link to their arrangement.

views/nebo.title: Nebo
views/nebo.description: A live map of the night sky: every naked eye star, the five visible planets, and the Moon in its exact phase, computed right in your browser from orbital mechanics. Drag time and watch dusk fall over the dome.

views/trails.title: Trails
views/trails.description: Somewhere over the Alps with no wifi, you want to know where you are and what that city under the wing is called.

views/share.title: Share
views/share.description: Put share. in front of any address on this site and you get a page built to be pointed at a phone: what the project is, what it does, and a QR code big enough to scan across a room.

views/about.title: About Domen Hribernik
views/about.description: About Domen Hribernik, a full-stack developer based in Celje, Slovenia: education, work experience, the technologies I use, and the projects I build.

views/projects.title: Project Portfolio
views/projects.description: The full edition: every project by Domen Hribernik on one broadsheet page, from client sites and passion builds to academic research. Updated as work ships.

views/store.title: Everbloom
views/store.description: Send a handcrafted 3D bouquet that blooms when they open it. Delivered by link, anywhere on earth, in one second. It never wilts.

views/rocks.title: Our Rock Pile
views/rocks.description: A small 3D museum of collected rocks built with Three.js. Spin each one around, read where it came from, and watch the pile grow one find at a time.

views/dnd.title: Session Zero
views/dnd.description: New to Dungeons and Dragons? Take a short quiz to find your class, then learn everything you need for your first session.

views/jeger.title: Dom's Jeger
views/jeger.description: Kontrolni seznam za domači zeliščni liker: katera zelišča so že nabrana, kaj še manjka in kdaj gre vse skupaj v žganje.

views/on-this-day.title: On This Day
views/on-this-day.description: On This Day, a daily almanac of history. Every event, birth and death recorded on today's date, drawn from Wikipedia.

views/blog/building-this-blog.title: Building a Blog With No Build Step
views/blog/building-this-blog.description: The whole site is hand written static files, so the blog had to be too. Here is how it reads Markdown straight from a folder with no framework, no bundler, and no database.

views/blog/in-praise-of-small-software.title: In Praise of Small Software
views/blog/in-praise-of-small-software.description: Most of the projects on this site solve a problem exactly one person had. That is not a limitation. It might be the whole point.
